query: I picked up a new sourdough starter from the local bakery yesterday, and it’s already bubbling so much I had to move it to a bigger jar this morning. I’m planning to bake my first loaf with it this weekend, I even picked up some fancy sea salt and whole grain flour to make it extra flavorful. Oh, and my cat knocked over my houseplant earlier, I spent twenty minutes cleaning potting soil off the kitchen rug before I could grab my phone to call you. Anyway, I’m having some issues with my phone right now—airplane mode is turned on and I can’t get my mobile data to work, it looks like my APN settings are all messed up too, can you help me fix this?
